resources.string: Tap any benefit to see exactly what you get.
See the live street map on every walk
Live map is Pro · Tap to unlock
Real streets under your route as you go
Watch your route draw itself over a real street map in real time, with follow mode, re-centre and your planned route on top.
Your walk is recorded exactly the same and drawn on a plain background. GPS, stats, pause and finish all work.
The full live street map behind your route. Pan and zoom any time.
Scan every packet you pick up
Point the camera at any barcode to get the food\'s verdict, calories and macros in a second.
Snap your plate to estimate calories and macros, or let AI read a nutrition label and ingredients list for you.
2 AI scans a day (photos and labels combined).
Unlimited meal photos and label scans.
Your meal plan is built around your calorie goal. Plan ahead for the whole week and regenerate it whenever you want fresh ideas.
All 7 days, plus regenerate the plan any time.
Miss a day without losing your streak
A freeze covers a missed day automatically, so one busy day doesn\'t reset weeks of progress. Freezes refill every month.
Bring back a streak you just lost
If your streak broke yesterday or the day before, repair the missed day and keep your streak as if nothing happened.
Repair one missed day each month (for streaks of 2 days or more).
Your distance over months and years
Switch the Progress chart from weeks to months or a whole year to see how far you\'ve really come.
All your best efforts in one place on the Progress screen, so you always know what to beat next.
Pace for every km or mile
Every activity summary breaks your walk into splits with a pace chart, so you can see where you sped up or slowed down.
Totals only: distance, time and average pace.
Per-km (or per-mile) splits and the pace chart on every walk.
Share your walks, weekly reports and competition results with designs that stand out in any feed.
Adds Dark, Minimal, Night and Sunset.
Pick the colour of your route on cards
Make your route pop on activity share cards in white, blue, green, pink or gold.
5 extra route colours to choose from.
Remove the Rave watermark from every card you share or save to your gallery.
Cards carry a small Rave watermark.
Start your own competition, set the goal and invite friends to race you on the leaderboard.
Create as many competitions as you like.
Streets still show with no signal
Save the map around you (2, 3 or 5 km) before you head out. GPS tracking works offline either way.
The map needs an internet connection.
Save areas for offline use and walk anywhere.
